Waste becomes

Circular economy

A loop that
never opens.

100% Recycled fibre

Zero virgin fibre. Every ton produced spares forest and keeps the board loop closed.

−40% Water use

Closed-circuit systems cut discharge compared with virgin pulp production.

−55% CO₂ emissions

Renewable energy integration reduces the footprint further at every stage.

Our pillars

Three decisions,
taken once.

Sustainability is not a department here. It was decided at the design stage of the mill, and it constrains everything built since.

01

Recycled
fibre.

100% recovered fibre. No virgin pulp. Our sourcing runs through local selective collection networks.

02

Responsible
energy.

High-efficiency systems and a progressive shift to renewables, reducing the footprint at every stage.

03

Circular
value.

What used to be thrown away becomes a dependable material for the next generation of packaging.

Commitments

Figures,
not promises.

Every commitment is measured, tracked and published. Our industrial model is built on transparency.

120K t/yr

Production capacity

120,000 tons of recycled board a year at launch, with a planned short-term extension.

500+ jobs

Direct social impact

Direct and indirect jobs created in Kénitra, with training programmes in industrial papermaking.

2030 target

Zero industrial landfill

Full recovery of by-products by 2030 — no unrecovered residue, no loss along the chain.
